newsitem.title: CANADA: Foreigners buy Canada securities in December.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners buy Canada securities in December.

text.p: Foreign investors bought a net C$1.13 billion of Canadian securities in February, after buying a revised net C$3.97 billion in January (revised from C$3.30 billion), Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.

Canadian residents bought a net C$572 million of foreign securities in February after buying C$1.83 billion in January (revised from C$1.32 billion). The February level was the smallest in eight months for Canadians buying foreign securities.
